candidate.title: BruChase-Seq
candidate.scope: The single BruChase-Seq route in the assigned Illumina schematic, from metabolic bromouridine pulse labeling through uridine chase, RNA recovery and antibody enrichment to cDNA library preparation. The left transcription cartoon is an overview, not a second workflow or branch. The displayed pre-capture hydrolysis route is preserved as a diagram observation and distinguished from post-elution fragmentation in the inspected primary implementation. Bru-Seq is mentioned in papers as a nascent-RNA reference assay; neither it nor TruSeq library preparation is an additional target method of this schematic. Sequencing and relative-stability comparisons explain the library readout but are not added as unshown graph operations.

features: The overview draws chromatin with gray nucleosomes, a blue RNA-polymerase icon, and purple nascent RNA with a yellow overlay and a small black terminal square. The overlay and square have no chemical legend.

operations.label: Label with bromouridine
operations.description: Newly synthesized RNA incorporates the Br label during a metabolic pulse, producing a labeled cohort rather than selecting RNA that was already present. The diagram labels the incorporation substrate Br-UTP; the primary implementation supplies bromouridine to cultured cells.
operations.mechanism: Metabolic labeling during transcription; bromouridine-containing RNA is the product. Br-UTP is a substrate label in the cartoon, not evidence that isolated polymerases are fed triphosphate in an in vitro run-on.
operations.information_effect: The incorporated Br residues associate RNA with the pulse interval and provide the later affinity handle.

evidence.rationale: The specified additions to cell medium are bromouridine for labeling and uridine for chase.

operations.label: Pulse chase
operations.description: Chase the labeled cells with unlabeled uridine, shown as UTP in the schematic. The previously labeled RNA cohort ages as RNA is processed and degraded; surviving pulse-labeled RNA retains its Br residues. The chase does not chemically strip Br residues from an otherwise surviving RNA.
operations.mechanism: Uridine chase following metabolic Br labeling. The paper defines the resulting samples as RNA populations of specific ages.
operations.information_effect: Survival of labeled RNA after the chase supports relative stability measurements when related to the starting labeled cohort. Recovery is not an absolute classification of every captured transcript as long-lived.

operations.label: Bead coated with anti BrdU antibody
operations.description: The mixture of RNA meets bead-immobilized anti-BrdU antibodies. Br-bearing RNA is retained on the bead, enriching the labeled material relative to the input mixture.
operations.mechanism: Affinity capture of bromouridine-containing RNA by anti-BrdU antibodies on magnetic beads. The antibodies and bead are capture reagents and attachment surfaces, not an independent biological target.
operations.information_effect: Affinity selection carries the pulse-label association into the retained RNA fraction. Selection does not by itself establish perfect biological specificity or measure a decay rate.
